name: Typed Decisions
description: System One typed decision provider: choice / score / boolean judgments with probability distributions for OpenClaw's decisionModel role.

endpoint.description: System One endpoint host (required to serve decisions). Accepts a bare host or an origin URL; the plugin appends /compatible-mode/v1/systemone.

keyFile.description: Path to a file holding the provider credential (0600). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/.secrets/decision-model.key.

credential.description: Inline provider credential. Prefer keyFile; this value lives in config and is stored in plaintext unless supplied as a SecretRef.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (host caps the effective deadline at 30000). Default 20000.

sysStatus.description: Once-per-session nudge that has the agent pin the shared sys-status board widget (kind typed-decisions:sys-status) through the core dashboard tool. Off unless netOrigins is configured. Fires on any session surface that carries the dashboard tool; a rejected turn does not spend the session nudge.

enabled.description: Set false to disable the nudge.

widgetPath.description: Path to the widget HTML fragment. Defaults to the packaged assets/sys-status-widget.html.

netOrigins.description: Exact HTTPS origins the widget may fetch. Required to enable the lane.

tools.description: Host tool bindings the widget may read (e.g. health, sessions.list, cron.list, agents.list).
